gain_loss: The census office gains nothing from making Jaisalmer look empty or full; its narrative pages also print boosterish lines ('almost equal to the state of Kerala', canal 'expected to be completely transformed'), which we treat as the office's wording, not as measurements.

title: Report on Aquifer Mapping and Ground Water Management, District Jaisalmer, Rajasthan (under XII Plan)
creator: Central Ground Water Board, Western Region, Jaipur (Ministry of Water Resources / Jal Shakti)
gain_loss: CGWB's job is to flag groundwater stress; a gloomy picture ('havoc picture of ground water') supports its management programme, so its adjectives are not used, only its measured values. Saved file was misnamed _2022 by the 1 Nov run; renamed _2017 to match the cover date (July 2017).
